name: Keep Gemini prompts cacheable: stable text first
gain: Google's words: implicit caching is on by default on Gemini 2.5 and newer, and savings are passed on when a request hits the cache (vendor claim). On gemini-3.6-flash, cached input is listed at $0.075 against $0.75 per 1M tokens through 31 Dec 2026.
how: Nothing to switch on. Put large, common content at the start of the prompt, send similar prefixes close together, and read total_cached_tokens in usage.
replaces: A changing value at the start of a long prompt.
trade_offs: The minimum is 4,096 tokens on Gemini 3.6 Flash and 3.8 Flash, and 2,048 on 2.5.
Explicit caching is not supported in the Interactions API or for Gemini 4 Argon and onward.
needs: Nothing new. PAT-prompt-caching-off does not detect this; show it only when the judge sees a changing value at the start of a long prompt.
usage_signal: Usage and Cost API: cached input tokens at or near zero on a model with large input

gain_model.formula: input_tokens * input_price * hit_rate * (1 - read_multiplier) - writes * input_price * (write_multiplier - 1)

test_recipe.what_to_compare: input cost and latency, identical answers

change_recipe.left_off: Nothing else changes; the new path sits behind a setting until a person turns it on
